facts.fact: The Ministry of Local Government's annual report for financial year 2023-2024 says its Digital Office works in real time with the twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities in the Council Project Management (CPM) system, in which all employees do their daily tasks in real time and can work remotely; it does not say where the system is hosted or how the offices are connected.
facts.system: twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities, working in the Council Project Management (CPM) system

facts.fact: The ministry says the I-Council project, piloted at the District Council of Moka from 27 August 2018 and extended by Government decision of 16 March 2020, took three years to implement in all Local Authorities, and that its Digital Office works in real time with twelve local authority digital offices: 12 of the 12 local authorities it counts (five municipal councils and seven district councils), stated in the report for financial year 2023-2024; the figure is of councils working online in the system, not of connections named as such.
facts.system: twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities, working in the Council Project Management (CPM) system

facts.fact: The ministry reports that the Local Authorities processed 24,393 Building and Land Use Permit applications between 1 July 2023 and 30 June 2024, and that its Land Use and Planning Unit manages the online National Electronic Licensing System (NELS) for the processing of those applications.
facts.system: Local Authorities' processing of permit applications in the National Electronic Licensing System (NELS)

facts.fact: The report for financial year 2023-2024 says the system the twelve local authority digital offices work in was built in house by a team of the District Council of Moka, was extended to the other Local Authorities by Government decision of 16 March 2020, and is run with a Digital Office at the Ministry of Local Government; no vendor or partner is named.
facts.system: twelve digital offices of the Local Authorities, working in the Council Project Management (CPM) system
